We've Heard it All. What types of projects can GenStone be used for? GenStone is commonly used for: - Accent walls - Fireplace surrounds - Garage facades - Porch columns - Entryways - Outdoor kitchens - Basement feature walls The panels can be used anywhere you want the look of real stone without the weight or cost. Rob Dean Senior Project Coordinator Can GenStone panels be installed over drywall? Yes. GenStone panels can typically be installed directly over drywall for interior projects as long as the wall structure is sound. Panels are attached to wall studs or other secure mounting points. Brian Cassel Senior Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone.
